title: Renal CT Benchmark: public five-class renal-tumor CT subtyping

description:
This reproducibility-focused software archive provides Renal CT Benchmark, a public-data ceiling study for five-class renal-tumor CT subtyping. It accompanies the manuscript A public-data ceiling for five-class renal tumor CT subtyping: radiomics, deep learning, and foundation models do not close the cross-institution gap.

The repository supports an independent rerun of one frozen protocol. Training uses UCSF-RMaC portal-venous cases. External testing uses RCC-AID (three classes) and KiTS23 (five classes). The primary metric is balanced accuracy. The ladder changes one factor at a time: a size-only logistic baseline (L0), frozen PyRadiomics features with XGBoost (L2), 3D ResNet training with two rebalancing ablations (L3), and linear probes of three CT foundation models (L4).

Included materials

  • Frozen fold file (data/ucsf_pv_stratified_split_5fold.csv): 532 public case identifiers, five-class labels, and folds 0–4. Seed 20261024 is for augmentation and initialization. Do not rebuild the folds with StratifiedKFold.
  • L0–L4 scripts (src/): size logistic regression, radiomics extraction, ResNet training, external evaluation, and the three linear probes.
  • Shell wrappers (scripts/): run_cv.sh, run_ext.sh, and run_l4.sh. Image and weight paths are environment variables or command-line arguments.

Repository layout

  • data/: the frozen fold file
  • src/: L0–L4, segmentation, and ROI crop
  • scripts/: cross-validation, external test, and L4 probe wrappers
  • CONTENTS.md: file list

Install and verify

Download UCSF-RMaC, RCC-AID, and KiTS23 from the providers named in the README. Download MMM/UMedPT, FMCIB, and CT-FM weights from their official records. Do not commit those files. Then:

bash scripts/run_cv.sh
bash scripts/run_ext.sh
bash scripts/run_l4.sh mmm

The analysis denominators are 532 UCSF-RMaC portal-venous cases, 91 RCC-AID patients, and 427 KiTS23 cases. External scores average the five fold-wise probability vectors. RCC-AID keeps the first three class probabilities and renormalizes each row with a denominator floor of 1e-8.

Data and privacy boundary

UCSF-RMaC remains available from UCSF Ci2, 10.58078/C2WC74 (CC BY 4.0). RCC-AID annotations are described in MELBA, 10.59275/j.melba.2026-2dg2. KiTS23 remains available from Zenodo, 10.5281/zenodo.7840133 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). This deposit archives code and the fold file only. Raw CT, masks, ROI volumes, large feature tables, and foundation-model weights are not redistributed. MMM/UMedPT weights are Zenodo record 11383543 under the Fraunhofer non-commercial research licence. FMCIB weights are 10.5281/zenodo.10528450 (CC BY-NC). CT-FM feature-extractor weights are the official Hugging Face model project-lighter/ct_fm_feature_extractor.
